readme.html:
SEO Skills for Claude Code, Cursor & AI Agents

30 open-source SKILL.md workflows that end in a merged PR or a file in your repo, not an audit PDF.

Web catalog · Install · Skills · Workflows · MCP servers · Sponsors · FAQ

Install

# All 30 skills
npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills

# One skill
npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --skill seo-autopilot

# List what is available
npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --list

Each skill is a folder with one Markdown SKILL.md that follows the Agent Skills specification. The agent reads only the name and description at startup and opens the full file when your prompt matches.

Environment Where SKILL.md lives Install
Claude Code .claude/skills/ or ~/.claude/skills/ npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a claude-code
Cursor .cursor/skills/ or .agents/skills/ npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a cursor
Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code .agents/skills/ npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills
ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Perplexity, Grok Paste the Markdown Copy any skill from il.ly/skills

What you get

Most SEO prompt packs produce checklists and health scores. Each skill here ends in something you can ship:

  • Diffs you can merge: rewritten titles and H1s, refreshed posts, robots.txt and bot rules, verified 301 maps, new /vs/ routes.
  • Proof in place of filler: proof-kb, seo-blog-images, and unslop-seo swap generic copy for your own benchmarks, screenshots, and charts.
  • One page at a time: blitz-seo puts 30 days of fixes, internal links, and backlinks on a single money page.
  • Google and AI search together: map the prompts buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews, track who gets cited, and ship pages for the prompts you are missing.

All 30 SEO skills

Technical, research, and on-page

Skill What it ships Example prompt
seo-autopilot A daily SEO agent for your repo with state in seo/: health checks, fact checks against recent commits, page-2 pushes, competitor sitemap diffs, a monthly keyword map "Run seo-autopilot on this repo and open a PR with today's top fix"
seo-roast A blunt teardown that fixes crawl, robots.txt, programmatic, layout, and AI-visibility blockers in a PR, then writes seo/roast-roadmap.md ordered by revenue "Run seo-roast on our repo and fix the fatal blockers in a PR"
blitz-seo A 30-day sprint plan to rank one page for one money keyword "Run a 30-day blitz-seo sprint to push /pricing from #14 to the top 3"
ahrefs-research Ahrefs MCP or API v3 workflows: competitor top-pages gaps (seo/competitor-gaps.md) with scaffolded routes, a fake-DR filter (seo/link-targets.csv), subreddit topic mining, link-insertion page matching "Use ahrefs-research to diff our top pages against 5 competitors and scaffold the #1 gap"
dataforseo-serp Live SERP workflows: keyword clusters by top-10 URL overlap (seo/keyword-clusters.json), a free-tool filter by CPC and volume, AI Overview citation sources, an intent check before you write "Use dataforseo-serp to cluster these 40 keywords so we don't cannibalize"
proof-kb A fact store in seo/kb/ (brand facts, benchmark and customer proof cards) that drafts pull from, plus route-fact to update every page when a number changes "Run proof-kb init and upgrade content/blog/postgres-branching.mdx with our benchmark"
vs-and-alternatives /vs/[competitor], /[competitor]-alternative, and "best for [persona]" routes built on sourced switching triggers, seat-based pricing math, and migration steps "Use vs-and-alternatives to ship /vs/billstack and link it from the footer"
internal-linking A link-graph audit (scripts/internal-link-graph.mjs) and body links from your top posts into /pricing, /vs/*, and /tools/* "Run internal-linking to fix orphan money pages"
domain-migration A rebrand or subdomain-to-subfolder move: full URL and backlink inventory, 1-hop 301 config, scripts/verify-redirects.sh, and backlink update emails "Run domain-migration to move blog.acme.com into acme.com/blog"
seo-title-optimization Title tag, frontmatter title, and H1 rewrites checked against the live SERP and truncation limits "Audit every page title in app/ and content/blog/ for CTR and truncation"
blog-refresher A refresh of a slipping post: compares it with the current top 10 and rewrites the weak sections in your voice "Use blog-refresher on content/blog/best-crm.mdx"
block-ai-scrapers A bot firewall that stops AI agents, curl, and headless scrapers from burning API and DB credits, keeps verified Googlebot indexing, and points blocked agents at your product "Add block-ai-scrapers to protect our /directory routes without hurting Googlebot"

End-to-end SEO workflows

The skills chain. Six that work well:

  1. Ship a post with first-hand proof. dataforseo-serp (cluster and check intent) → proof-kb (add your benchmarks) → seo-blog-images → unslop-seo → internal-linking → parasite-and-pr.
  2. Win buyers leaving a competitor. ahrefs-research (diff their top pages) → vs-and-alternatives → reddit-serp → honest-link-outreach.
  3. Push a page-2 URL into the top 3. seo-title-optimization → blog-refresher → intro → linkdr (2-4 DR 40+ links at the refreshed URL).
  4. Get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. customer-journey → aiseotracker → ai-seo-report → content-coverage.
  5. Launch from DR 0. understand-customers → blitz-copy → directory-submissions and awesome-tools → blitz-seo.
  6. Daily repo SEO. Run seo-autopilot on a schedule so the agent checks site health, verifies claims against recent commits, and opens PRs. Add diff-marketing weekly to turn shipped code into posts.

Live SEO data via MCP servers

A skill is the method. An MCP server gives the agent live data to run it on. Three are preconfigured in .mcp.json:

Server Endpoint What it gives the agent
AI SEO Tracker https://aiseotracker.com/api/agent/mcp (repo) Prompt rankings, cited URLs, and competitor share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews
Scribiz https://scribiz.com/mcp Transcripts with speakers, on-screen text, summaries, and chapters
Awesome Tools https://awesome.tools/mcp (repo) Tool search, directory submissions, and backlink verification

Related, not in .mcp.json: the LinkDR agent skill plans backlink orders and returns one checkout link, and the GenPPT MCP turns an audit or roadmap into a .pptx or PDF deck.

FAQ

What are SEO skills for AI agents?

A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: instructions, checks, and output templates that teach a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf) one SEO job, such as a technical audit, a title rewrite, a content refresh, or a backlink plan.

How do I use them in Claude Code or Cursor?

Run npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills in your project, or globally. The agent loads a skill when your prompt matches its description. You can also name it: "Use blog-refresher on content/blog/post.mdx".

Can I use them in ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Perplexity?

Yes. Open il.ly/skills, pick a skill, and copy the prompt into the chat.

What is the difference between a skill and an MCP server?

A skill tells the agent how to do the job. An MCP server connects it to live data and actions: SERPs, AI citation scans, transcripts, checkouts. Most workflows here use both.
